settings.text:
Every idea starts with a problem. Ours was simple: premium-quality golf products are too expensive.

Blue Tees Golf is different than traditional brands. Why? Again, it’s simple: Blue Tees Golf makes premium golf rangefinders and accessories and sells them directly to you. Our products are as good or better than anything out there, but with a direct-to-consumer first strategy we can pass the savings into your pocket.

You can stop reading now. But if you’re curious—and we hope you are—here’s a bit more about our story.

We’re four friends who love to golf. We wanted a new golf rangefinder, so we went on Amazon and bought an inexpensive rangefinder and after a few short weeks, it broke, the eye piece popped off. We gave it a mulligan, and bought another company’s rangefinder, rinse and repeat, same story. It broke pretty quickly, too.  After trying one more time with the same end result, we began wondering: Why was it this difficult to find a high-quality, well-designed rangefinder without breaking the bank?

It turns out there’s a simple explanation (noticing a theme?). Golf equipment is a multibillion-dollar industry dominated by a few brands who command artificially-high price points and reap unnecessarily large profits from you and me.

Why do we buy from them? Well, do we really have another option? Yeah, that’s what we thought, too.

Instead of settling, we took matters into our own hands and started Blue Tees Golf.

By utilizing our industrial design expertise, selling direct-to-consumer, cutting out complex operations and designing our products in-house, we began creating high-quality, high-performance, golf products at a fraction of the price of our competitors.

Now, golfers like us, are turning to Blue Tees Golf every day for our quality, customer care, and savings.

Not totally convinced? We understand. That’s why all of our products come with a 60-day money back satisfaction guarantee and a 2-year manufacturer warranty.

Save your money & have fun when you play more rounds with Blue Tees Golf on your bag.

settings.hero_description: The Captain Air brings connected, pro-grade precision to every golfer. With Bluetooth connectivity and seamless integration with the Blue Tees GAME app, you’ll unlock yardages for 42,000+ courses, slope-adjusted distances, and a clean, intuitive display. Compact, waterproof, and always ready, Captain Air gives you the confidence to play smarter—whether it’s your first rangefinder or your next connected upgrade.

settings.sectionDescription: A high-contrast display with dual color modes keeps yardages easy to read in any lighting.
Lock onto pins faster with 6X optical magnification and a 1000-yard measurement range. Together, they give you the long-range visibility and tour-level accuracy to attack every shot with confidence.
Instantly see crystal-clear yardages for any course you play, helping you choose smarter targets and commit with confidence.
Built-in Bluetooth tracking helps you locate your device in seconds—no more digging through carts or bags to find it.
AI analyzes your shot history to recommend the best club for each situation, helping you make smarter decisions instantly – displayed right in the ocular chamber.
Automatically factors slope, wind, elevation, and temperature into your yardages, giving you real-world numbers you can trust on every swing.

settings.hero_description: Toggle slope-adjusted distances on or off with ease —practice smarter, play legal.

settings.sectionDescription: A powerful magnet snaps securely to carts, posts, and metal surfaces, keeping Captain Air accessible and out of the way.
Engineered to perform in any condition—rain, wind, dust, or heat—so your round never stops when the weather turns.
